technology.title: Inside the Smart Money Engine
technology.subtitle: Unlike typical trading algorithms using standard indicators, our exclusive strategy is based on Smart Money Concepts to identify institutional trading patterns and find perfect entries.

trend.title: HTF Orderblocks Detection
trend.description: Identifies High Timeframe Orderblocks where institutional traders have placed large orders, creating significant support and resistance zones.

benefits.1: Scans multiple timeframes for institutional order clusters (1h, 4h, 1d, 1w)
benefits.2: Detects orderblocks formed by large market participants
benefits.3: Identifies areas where smart money has accumulated positions
benefits.4: Provides high-probability reversal zones based on institutional activity
benefits.5: Filters out retail noise to focus on professional trading patterns

trend.alert: Orderblocks represent areas where large institutional traders have placed significant orders, creating powerful support/resistance levels that drive market direction.

signals.title: Fair Value Gaps
signals.description: Detects Fair Value Gaps created during high volatility periods where price gaps from institutional order flow create future magnet areas.

benefits.1: Identifies price gaps created by large institutional orders
benefits.2: Tracks areas where price needs to return for balance
benefits.3: Provides high-probability entry points when price revisits gaps
benefits.4: Combines with orderflow analysis for confirmation
benefits.5: Creates magnetic zones that attract price movement

signals.alert: Fair Value Gaps occur when price moves rapidly due to large orders, creating imbalances that price must eventually correct, providing predictable entry opportunities.

confirm.title: Liquidity Zones
confirm.description: Maps out liquidity zones where stop losses and limit orders cluster, allowing the algorithm to anticipate institutional stop hunts.

benefits.1: Identifies areas where retail traders place stop losses
benefits.2: Maps institutional liquidity sweeps and stop hunts
benefits.3: Provides optimal entry timing around liquidity zones
benefits.4: Avoids entering trades during high-risk liquidity sweeps
benefits.5: Maximizes profit potential by understanding market maker tactics

confirm.alert: Liquidity zones represent areas where market makers can trigger stop losses and create liquidity for their large orders, creating predictable price movements.

risk.title: LTF Confirmations
risk.description: Uses Lower Timeframe confirmations to find perfect entry timing after HTF setups are identified, ensuring optimal risk-reward ratios.

benefits.1: Waits for lower timeframe confirmation after HTF setups
benefits.2: Provides precise entry timing with minimal slippage
benefits.3: Ensures trades align with both macro and micro market structure
benefits.4: Reduces false signals through multi-timeframe validation
benefits.5: Optimizes entry points for maximum profit potential

risk.alert: LTF confirmations ensure we enter trades at the most optimal price levels, combining the power of higher timeframe analysis with precise lower timeframe timing.

size.title: Smart Position Sizing
size.description: Implements intelligent position sizing based on risk appetite, market volatility, and setup quality to protect capital while maximizing returns.

benefits.1: Adjusts position size based on selected risk appetite
benefits.2: Scales exposure according to market volatility conditions
benefits.3: Increases size on higher-quality setups, reduces on weaker ones
benefits.4: Implements maximum drawdown protection across the portfolio
benefits.5: Supports compounding growth while maintaining risk control

size.alert: Smart position sizing ensures optimal capital allocation, adjusting exposure based on market conditions and setup quality to maximize returns while protecting your investment.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about Zillions
faq.a1: No. Zillions is built so anyone can participate. The engine adapts to markets for you.
faq.a2: No - it's on‑chain and non‑custodial. You can track execution and history transparently.
faq.a3: No. Markets involve risk. The system aims to grow capital by aligning to dominant regimes, but losses are possible.
faq.a4: Smart Money Concept (SMC) or Inner Circle Trader (ICT) methodology analyzes institutional trading patterns. It identifies areas where large institutional traders place orders, including HTF Orderblocks (support/resistance zones), Fair Value Gaps (price imbalances), and Liquidity Zones (where retail stops cluster). Our algorithm uses these concepts to find optimal entry points that align with professional trading behavior.
faq.a5: Invitation Only. You have to get invited by someone you know.
